part2.question: A time when you got up early

segments.v: I want to talk about a morning when I got up very early. It was last February. I woke up at 3:30 am. I went to Quảng Bá flower market with my friend Linh. It is a flower market near West Lake and it is open at night. My dad drove us there at 4 am. It was cold and dark but there were many people and flowers. The sellers carried many flowers on their motorbikes. We took many photos. When the sun came up, we ate sticky rice near the lake. We got up early because the market is only busy at night. I felt very tired but happy. It was a special experience.
